column1: DIRECTIONAL MODEL - the breakthrough: predict UP/DOWN, not exact price
Direction is FAR more predictable than price level. This is what actually drives hold vs sell decisions.
OUTLOOK: UNANIMOUS DOWN across all horizons. This is a SELL-SIDE signal - lean toward selling
into current strength rather than holding. Expected level Rs 38,100-38,500 over 1-3 months.
HOW TO USE / WHEN DIRECTION CHANGES:
- Re-run this model each time new mandi data arrives (twice weekly).
- Watch for CONFIDENCE dropping toward 50% - that signals the direction is about to flip.
- A flip from DOWN to UP (with >65% confidence) is your signal to stop selling and start holding.
- Key price level to watch: Rs 39,200 (today). If price rises above this while model still says DOWN, sell harder.
- Model drivers: coking coal trend, Turkey scrap trend, own momentum, MACD, margin proxy, BDI, USD/INR.
